Found while proving dev#267 (PR #741) live. `uv run openbrain-memory` from a checkout of `origin/main` (`c7bf1b9`, same on `wip/2026-08-18`) refuses the live server before writing:

```
direct get_contract did not prove the first-class runtime contract: contract_version str(len=27, sha256=8fa7d514...) is not compatible; expected one of: str(len=27, sha256=1c144ab2...); schema_hash mismatch: expected ...ceab458b, got ...81c29ab7; capability agent_context_pack.version must be >= 3; tool_contracts[agent_context_pack].version must be >= 3
```

The installed `openbrain-memory` 0.9.0 tool (`~/.local/share/uv/tools/openbrain-memory`) accepts the same server and writes `saved`. So `main` carries a client contract bump (`agent_context_pack` v3, new `schema_hash`) that the live server does not serve: MERGED, not RUNNING. Until the server side is deployed, any reinstall of the client from `main` turns every head capture into `lost` at `get_contract`.

Ask: deploy the server side of the v3 contract (or pin the client expectation to what is live) before the next client reinstall. State: RUNNING (observed 2026-08-24 04:05Z), reproducible with the command above.
